narrative.intro: Triad National Security has $5.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Triad National Security received one award this fiscal year, giving an average award size of $5.3B, and obligations are up 1.5% year over year. Historical obligations show a steady climb from FY21 through FY26: FY21 and FY22 were each $4B, FY23 was $4.6B, FY24 and FY25 were each $5.2B, and FY26 is $5.3B. The data are reported as contract obligations except where table notes indicate award-value totals, and current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. This profile suits buyers, compliance teams, and prime contractors who track large national security laboratory contracts or need a compact view of a high-value supplier. Use the numbers here to compare Triad National Security to other vendors, to check budget alignment, or to flag opportunities for teaming on follow-on work given the single large award that dominates the current-year total.
